name: iflow-for-vscode
description: Bring IFlow (iflow CLI) into VS Code: chat panel, commands, and editor-group lock.

iflow.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js executable (v22+). Required if your default Node version is too old. Example: ~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.0.0/bin/node

iflow.baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g. https://apis.iflow.cn/v1). Only set this if you need the extension to override the CLI's configured endpoint.

iflow.oauthClientId.description: OAuth client id used for iFlow login (PKCE public client).

iflow.oauthRequestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for OAuth HTTPS requests (token exchange, refresh, and user info).

iflow.port.description: Port for iFlow CLI WebSocket server

iflow.enableCliStream.description: Start iFlow CLI with --stream for incremental response chunks. Disable only if your CLI/runtime has compatibility issues.

iflow.interactionTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for pending permission/question/plan interactions.

iflow.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum file size in bytes for attached files

iflow.autoIncludeWorkspaceFiles.description: Whether to include workspace file list in every prompt. Disabled by default for faster first-token latency.

iflow.workspaceFilesLimit.description: Maximum number of workspace files to include when iflow.autoIncludeWorkspaceFiles is enabled.

iflow.streamRenderIntervalMs.description: Streaming UI refresh interval in milliseconds. Lower values feel smoother but use more CPU; higher values reduce CPU use but update less frequently. Recommended range: 30-200ms.

iflow.debugSessionUpdateOnly.description: Only show [ACP] session/update summary logs (with toolCallId) in the IFlow output channel (and debug console when debugLogging is enabled).

iflow.subagentInactivityTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for sub-agent inactivity detection. If no notifications arrive from the CLI for this duration during a tool call, the operation is cancelled and the main agent is informed. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 300000 (300 seconds).

iflow.showStatusBar.description: Show the CWD (current working directory) status bar above the Composer input.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile-tests && c8 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary mocha --ui tdd --require ./test/unit/vscode-shim.js "out/test/**/*.test.js"
